versions.changelog:
- Skill name changed from "pixwith-media-generation" to "pixwith-ai".
- Minor formatting update to setup instructions (numbered steps now use dashes for consistency).
- No workflow, feature, or functionality changes included in this update.

- Initial release of Pixwith AI video and image generation skill, supporting 40+ models.
- Enables text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-image, and image-to-image creation via Pixwith through OpenClaw MCP.
- Guides users through first-time setup, including MCP and API key configuration.
- Handles dynamic model discovery, schema inspection, credit checking, and reference image upload according to Pixwith API requirements.
- Provides thorough workflow and guardrails to ensure reliable, schema-compliant media generation and error feedback.
